reader: Claude Opus 5.5, research reader with source access
reason: The image-only reading took the lemmata for other words ('Dicas quercuum', 'Est primo varia ... decetero') and left the commentary largely illegible; the lines relied on were reread on the native images and their expansions revised with the printed text in hand.
sources: Nomina et verba defectiva [cum commento], [Mainz: Peter Friedberg, c. 1493], GW M13741, BSB 4 Inc.s.a. 844, MDZ bsb00039573, scans 35 and 45 (page images)
Nomina et verba defectiva, [Hagenau: Heinrich Gran, 1491], GW M13735, BSB 4 Inc.s.a. 843, MDZ bsb00070934, scan 27 (page image)
D. Reichling, Das Doctrinale des Alexander de Villa-Dei (Berlin, 1893), v. 339 and apparatus, archive.org dasdoctrinaledes00alex (text)
text:
Source-assisted reading (research reader), made on the native images after the image-only first reading stams5-2026-11-01-image-only; not blind for the second block.

Reread on the image (canvas 1):
- the first text block, verse lines and commentary, in three bands, read before the source was found, with expansions revised after comparing the Mainz c. 1493 print of Nomina et verba defectiva (MDZ bsb00039573, scan 35);
- the second text block, upper and lower bands, read with scan 45 of that print in hand;
- on canvas 4, two bands of the glossed Isaiah flap.

Lines 1-17 of the second block were also read by an independent checker; those readings are given in the report, not here.
Canvas 0, the left-edge cursive strip and the textualis turn-ins were not reread.

Images:
- canvas 1: https://fragmentarium.ms/loris/F-v7op/Stams_STA_Frg_091_01v_1_.jpg
- canvas 4: https://fragmentarium.ms/loris/F-v7op/Stams_STA_Frg_091_01v_4_.jpg
Both are 7360 x 4912.

Conventions:
- Regions are x,y,width,height in native pixels.
- Expansions are in ( ).
- ? marks an uncertain reading; ... marks words not read; [ ] marks lost or supplied text.

A. First block, top: canvas 1, 2350,1380,1800,700
(verse) Em dat et en quartus reliquos recto[s]? [socia]m(us)
(gloss) ... s(cilicet) ...
(verse) Est? p(ri)mo varia s(ed)? plurali[a] car[uere]
In illa p(ar)te autor ponit defe[c]tu(m)? et declinacione(m) illo(rum) duo(rum)? penolope
et penthecoste. Dicit ergo sic q(uod) q(uan)do? grec(us) n(omi)n(ativus) ... in e tunc g(eni)t(ivus)
... in es et ac(cusativu)s in em v(e)l en et alii? cas(us) ... de q(ui)b(us)? ... m(enci)o
fiant in e sicut n(omi)n(ativu)s ... declinant(ur) in sing(ulari) ... in plurali? manent? indeclina[bilia]. Ex quo p(atet) q(uod) ali[a]?

... q(uod) in autor(e)? ... hic posit(is)? ... alia in...
